symbols.content: Inductive nat : Type := | O | S (n : nat).
Definition succ (n : nat) : nat := S n.
symbols.doc: Successor (documentation reworded in v2; content fingerprint unchanged).

symbols.content: Fixpoint add (n m : nat) : nat := match n with | O => m | S k => S (add k m) end. (* v2: guarded reduction clauses *)
symbols.doc: Primitive recursion addition (v2 adds guarded reduction clauses).

symbols.content: Fixpoint even (n : nat) : Prop := match n with | O => True | S k => odd k end.
Fixpoint odd (n : nat) : Prop := match n with | O => False | S k => even k end.
Axiom peano_induction : forall P : nat -> Prop, P O -> (forall n, P n -> P (S n)) -> forall n, P n. (* v2: strengthened well-founded statement *)
Axiom classic : forall P : Prop, P \/ ~P.
symbols.doc: External classical axiom, requires human audit.

symbols.content: Lemma add_zero : forall n, add n O = n. Proof. induction n; auto. Qed.
symbols.doc: Zero is a right identity (renamed add_zero -> add_zero_rw in v2; identity transfers only via mapping).

symbols.content: Lemma add_succ : forall n m, add n (S m) = S (add n m). Proof. induction n; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma add_comm : forall n m, add n m = add m n. Proof. induction n; simpl; rewrite <- add_zero_rw; f_equal; auto. Qed.
symbols.doc: Commutativity of addition (v2 proof script changed; fingerprint differs).

symbols.content: Lemma add_assoc : forall n m k, add n (add m k) = add (add n m) k. Proof. induction n; simpl; auto. Qed.
symbols.doc: Associativity, newly added in v2: no prior proof exists.

symbols.content: Lemma even_or_odd : forall n, even n \/ odd n. Proof. induction n using peano_induction; apply classic; auto. Qed.
symbols.doc: Every number is even or odd. Fingerprint unchanged but the peano axiom changed, so replay is required.

symbols.content: Lemma double_even : forall n, even (add n n). Proof. induction n; simpl; rewrite add_zero; auto. Qed.
